purpose: 在不改变 Chignolin central-tangent IR-IVM 算法身份的前提下，以预登记的阶段式三参数搜索测试其在 Barnase--Barstar 上是否优于当前 IVM，并为统一的 arc-length 500 指标与最终作图选择正式路径。

algorithm_identity.name: Chignolin-transfer IR-IVM, central-tangent branch
algorithm_identity.frozen_subproblem: discrete_b040 joint inexact normal proximal subproblem
algorithm_identity.reparameterization: mandatory state_curve after every outer iteration
algorithm_identity.recovery: the unchanged Chignolin/Ala recovery transaction: 320-call allowance, 15 inner calls, bicriteria merge, I_perp rtol 0
forbidden_changes_during_search: removing, delaying, weakening, or conditionally bypassing state_curve reparameterization or recovery
changing eta, history, the physical 1 A atom-step cap, FFrbk rebuild frequency, or shifted solve
using online arc-length diagnostics or baseline results to alter an optimization trajectory

number_of_forces_contract.definition: 本优化运行对 30 个内部图像发出的每一次真实联合 OpenMM energy/Force getState 尝试；一次尝试计一次 NoF。

fixed_endpoint_policy.source: hash-verified inherited canonical endpoint joint E/F cache

included: all recovery and rollback intermediate trials
failed internal getState attempts, with the run then classified as failed
excluded: cache hits on previously evaluated internal coordinates
call-free geometry, sparse FFrbk construction, and linear algebra
number_of_forces_contract.successful_run_audit: backend joint getState attempts = backend successful joint evaluations = sum of 30 internal-image cache misses = registered budget; endpoint attempts = endpoint misses = 0; no overshoot
number_of_forces_contract.failure_policy: A failed getState attempt remains charged. The run is preserved and reported as failed, and it cannot enter scientific ranking.

eligible_path_states.scientifically_eligible: the common initial path after its 30 internal E/F values are available, or a fully evaluated path with reparam_committed=true
eligible_path_states.promotion_requires: at least one fully evaluated reparam_committed path after the initial path
ineligible: an open or partial terminal transaction
eligible_path_states.same_state_rule: I_perp and Delta E used together must come from the same eligible path state; minima from different states may not be combined.

optimization_period_sparse_ranking.purpose: 在正式 arc-length 500 之前，用优化已经支付的 32-image 路径数据进行控制变量筛选；这些量只用于选参，不能作为最终加密指标发表。

sparse_Delta_E.definition: max energy among the 32 sparse images minus the first endpoint energy, converted to kcal/mol
sparse_Delta_E.diagnostic_limitation: This sparse-image value may miss an inter-image energy maximum and is never renamed Delta E_500.

per_state_normalization.u_I: sparse I_perp(state) / sparse I_perp(common initial path)
per_state_normalization.u_E: sparse Delta E(state) / sparse Delta E(common initial path)

optimization_period_sparse_ranking.per_run_score_at_budget_B: Among eligible post-initial reparam_committed states with optimization NoF <= B, choose the one state with the smallest joint_score.
ranking_order: smaller u_I on that same state
smaller u_E on that same state
smaller actual optimization NoF of that state
registered lexicographic order of alpha, then r, then m_max
optimization_period_sparse_ranking.right_censoring: A run that passes its NoF audit but has not produced a post-initial reparam_committed path is recorded as not yet rankable at that budget, not as having reached any precision.

staged_search.purpose: exercise a full inexact update, mandatory state_curve reparameterization or recovery, and the 30-image NoF ledger before parameter search
pass_conditions: all construction, input-hash, CPU1, lock, memory, and storage gates pass
optimization endpoint getState attempts and endpoint misses are both zero
the 30-image backend/ledger audit is exact and has no overshoot
at least one reparameterization transaction closes
a terminal partial tail, if present, is charged and quarantined
staged_search.registered_budget_extension: If the 240-NoF run is otherwise valid but has not yet produced a post-initial reparam_committed path, repeat the identical setting from the common initial path at budget 480. Do not change a parameter or bypass reparameterization.
staged_search.failure_action: Do not begin parameter search until an audited smoke run passes.

staged_search.promotion: Promote the best three audited parameter settings by the frozen sparse ranking to independent 990-NoF runs from the common initial path.
staged_search.retained_for_interaction: After the 990-NoF confirmation, retain alpha_star and the second-ranked alpha_2.

fixed.alpha: alpha_star from the confirmed alpha scan

staged_search.promotion: Promote the best three audited parameter settings by the frozen sparse ranking to independent 990-NoF runs from the common initial path.
staged_search.retained_for_interaction: After the 990-NoF confirmation, retain r_star and the second-ranked r_2.

staged_search.promotion: Promote the best three audited parameter settings by the frozen sparse ranking to independent 990-NoF runs from the common initial path.
staged_search.retained_for_interaction: After the 990-NoF confirmation, retain m_star and the second-ranked m_2.

staged_search.reuse_rule: An existing run is reused only when parameter values, budget, source closure, inputs, oracle, storage policy, thread policy, and all algorithm controls are hash-identical; otherwise an independent run is required.

staged_search.candidate_pool: all distinct audited settings with a 990-NoF result from the three controlled scans and the registered local interaction check
staged_search.promotion: Promote the best three settings by the frozen sparse ranking to independent 2040-NoF runs from the common initial path.
staged_search.cross_host_control: All promoted 2040-NoF runs must be repeated on one reference host chosen and recorded before their first E/F call, so final selection does not assume cross-host bitwise identity.

staged_search.diagnostic: Apply the frozen arc-length 500 protocol to every scientifically eligible path of each candidate after all three optimization runs are sealed.
staged_search.promotion: Promote the best two settings by the final arc500 ranking to independent 4080-NoF runs from the common initial path on the same reference host.

staged_search.diagnostic: Extend the same arc-length 500 histories with every newly eligible path after both optimization runs are sealed.
staged_search.winner_rule: The first-ranked setting by the final arc500 ranking always receives an independent 9990-NoF run from the common initial path.
staged_search.runner_up_rule: The second setting also receives a 9990-NoF run if its final joint score is no more than 1.10 times the first setting's score, or if their best eligible paths are Pareto-incomparable in arc500 I_perp and Delta E_500.

staged_search.input: every completed 9990-NoF IR-IVM result selected above, the immutable current BB IVM baseline, and the immutable standard ODE-NEB baseline
staged_search.diagnostic: Apply one identical arc-length 500 protocol to every plotted eligible path; diagnostic results cannot change an already completed optimization trajectory.
staged_search.winner_prefix_reproducibility: The selected 9990-NoF history must reproduce the same setting's shorter reference-host history through every fully closed state before the shorter budget boundary, excluding wall time and a quarantined terminal partial tail. A mismatch blocks the formal claim.

insufficient_rankable_results_rule.at_480: If fewer than the requested promotion count are rankable, extend every otherwise valid, audited, not-yet-rankable setting once to 990 before selecting. Do not fill a promotion place with a failed run.
insufficient_rankable_results_rule.at_990: Continue with fewer candidates only if at least two audited settings are rankable for each two-value interaction set; otherwise stop and report the staged search as inconclusive.
insufficient_rankable_results_rule.all_failed_or_no_committed_paths: Stop. Diagnose the migration without changing this protocol or launching a result-dependent replacement parameter.

arc_length_500_protocol.timing: strictly offline after the relevant optimization results and candidate identities are sealed
arc_length_500_protocol.path_representation: piecewise linear through the selected 32-image path
arc_length_500_protocol.evaluator: the same canonical OpenMM 8.1.2 CPU/double joint E/F oracle for every compared method and path
arc_length_500_protocol.diagnostic_endpoint_calls: Both endpoints are freshly evaluated as two of the 500 diagnostic points; these calls belong only to the diagnostic ledger and do not alter optimization NoF.
arc_length_500_protocol.I_perp: normalized central-chord perpendicular force with interior half-adjacent-chord unnormalized quadrature; endpoint contribution zero; units eV^2/A
arc_length_500_protocol.Delta_E_500: max_j E(x(s_j)) - E(x(s_0)), converted to kcal/mol
arc_length_500_protocol.control_variable_rule: Every compared eligible path uses exactly this same 500-point protocol; dense400 values may be used only as immutable historical checks and cannot be relabeled as arc500.

fixed_joint_targets.source: the acceptance thresholds in the immutable official BB baseline index; the arc500 protocol itself remains newly and uniformly evaluated

ranking_order: smaller observed optimization NoF at which both fixed targets are first satisfied on the same eligible path
if no joint first passage exists, smaller minimum per-state joint score without mixing path states
smaller I_perp ratio on that same state
smaller Delta E_500 ratio on that same state
final_arc500_ranking.right_censoring: A method that has not reached both targets is reported as not yet observed to reach them by its last eligible optimization NoF; that last NoF is not called a first-passage cost.

baseline_comparison.current_BB_IVM: the immutable 32-image, 30-paid-interior DiscreteIVM30 alpha=0.020, no-reparameterization NF9990 producer bound by the official index
baseline_comparison.ODE_NEB: the immutable 32-image standard ASE ode12r, k=0.1 eV/A^2, NF9990 producer bound by the official index
baseline_comparison.comparison_NoF: Use each method's actual optimization Number of Forces. The inherited endpoint cache contributes zero optimization NoF to IR-IVM, matching the formal 30-interior accounting without an endpoint offset.
strict_success_against_current_IVM: a smaller joint first-passage optimization NoF for the fixed two-metric targets
or, if joint first passage is not observed for both methods, a strict Pareto improvement at the same available optimization NoF: both arc500 metrics no worse and at least one strictly better
baseline_comparison.incomparable_result: If one arc500 metric improves and the other worsens, report the two methods as Pareto-incomparable rather than declaring a single winner.

stopping_and_reproducibility.registered_budgets_are_terminal: Do not stop a run early because an online or offline metric looks favorable; stop only at its registered budget or a recorded failure/resource gate.
stopping_and_reproducibility.infrastructure_retry: An infrastructure retry must use the same immutable member registration and execution authorization and is not a new scientific setting.
stopping_and_reproducibility.algorithmic_failure: Preserve and report it; do not replace it with a favorable unregistered setting.
stopping_and_reproducibility.source_change: Any source, algorithm, input, endpoint cache, oracle, or scientific storage-policy change after the first E/F call invalidates reuse of earlier members and requires a new versioned protocol rather than editing this file.
stopping_and_reproducibility.no_automatic_search_expansion: Failure to beat the baseline ends this registered staged search as a negative or inconclusive result. Any broader search must be preregistered as a new campaign before its first E/F call.

resource_and_storage_gates.concurrency: one heavy Barnase--Barstar run per host, host-local fcntl lock, jobs=1; an existing BB lock is never bypassed
resource_and_storage_gates.threads: OPENMM_CPU_THREADS, OMP_NUM_THREADS, MKL_NUM_THREADS, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS, VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS, and NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS all equal 1 before Python starts
resource_and_storage_gates.mutagen: Source, registrations, and sealed-result movement must pass the existing Mutagen gates; no alternate unsynchronized checkout may launch an authorized member.
resource_and_storage_gates.reference_host: The reference host for the 2040/4080/9990 confirmation sequence is selected for resource availability and frozen in the execution authorization before the first promoted E/F call, never from scientific results.
resource_and_storage_gates.storage_mode: committed: retain the initial path, every fully reparam-committed path, final eligible path, complete NoF/recovery audit arrays, WAL/seals, and hashes; storage history is never read by the online algorithm
resource_and_storage_gates.storage_equivalence_gate: The committed storage mode must pass the existing zero-Force full/thin prefix and final-state equivalence tests before authorization.
resource_and_storage_gates.archive_policy: Do not delete or compact an unsealed paid-E/F or diagnostic artifact. Seal hashes and provenance before any approved storage move.

claim_scope.search_description: pre-registered staged three-parameter search with controlled one-parameter scans and one local 2 x 2 x 2 interaction check
forbidden_claims: found the global optimum over all 240 combinations
proved a parameter monotonicity outside the evaluated settings
claim_scope.required_reporting: List every executed parameter setting, actual optimization NoF, audit status, eligible committed-path count, right-censoring status, source/input hashes, and whether it arose from a controlled scan, interaction check, or budget prolongation. Unevaluated combinations remain explicitly untested.

execution_gate: This protocol authorizes no physical call by itself. Each run still requires an immutable per-member registration and a later execution authorization binding the hashes of that member registration, CAMPAIGN_PREREGISTRATION.json, MIGRATION_CONTRACT.json, and this STAGED_SEARCH_PROTOCOL.json.
